sensei_drum.brief: Generate experimental drum patterns using chopping, slicing, and stutter effects to maintain club energy.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines with granular synthesis and looping sample chops to support emotional mood.

harmony_generator.brief: Design chord textures employing time stretch and reversed slicing techniques for harmonic interest.

melody_generator.brief: Produce melodic elements with pitch shifting and glitch sample chops emphasizing emotional expression.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate overall arrangement energy curve and ensure variation aligns with club energy and emotional mood.

presetor.brief: Manage sample chopping technique presets and maintain consistent channel naming conventions.

songgps.brief: Track progress and ensure arrangement sections meet energy targets and emotional intent.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix unprocessed channel audio to balance layers emphasizing sample chop textures.
